data.name: Cli.Help
data.value:
UseControl: restrictions for standard Windows accounts. Run as administrator.
uc status state of the service and of every restricted account uc apply apply the configuration now (and turn restrictions back on) uc suspend [--yes] remove all restrictions until "uc apply" uc preview every rule that would be written, and why uc audit security check of this PC
uc users list | add <name> | remove <name> uc games allow <hours> | lock games for a limited time (0.25 to 24 hours) uc games find [--add] look for game folders that are not blocked yet
uc block folder <path> [--category games|vpn|tools|other] uc block name <file.exe> [--category ...] uc block file <path to .exe> [--category ...] by fingerprint: renaming does not help uc unblock folder <path> | name <file.exe> | file <path or SHA-256> uc allow folder <path> a program folder that runs inside a blocked place uc allow remove <path>
uc access deny|allow <path> [--rights read,write,execute,delete|full] [--users a,b] uc access remove <path>
uc ext allow|remove chrome|edge|firefox <extension id> uc policy set chrome|edge|firefox <name> <value> uc policy remove chrome|edge|firefox <name>
uc config export <file> | import <file> uc ping | help
Options: --json (status, preview, audit, games find), --lang en|uk
